caption: The drawing depicts a metallic hand tool resembling a pair of pliers or tongs. It has two elongated, rounded handles that taper to wider ends, shown in a grayish color consistent with steel or iron. The tool’s handles are connected by a joint near their centers, allowing them to pivot. One side of the tool has a cylindrical peg extending outward, while the interior near the joint features several protruding pegs and cutouts. The background is plain and off-white, and below the tool, there is a small inscription that reads: "MATEL G. CEDILLO – TAOS". The overall composition focuses on the tool, centered on the page, with detailed shading to illustrate its metallic texture and three-dimensional form.
title: Bullet Mold
